Firsthand Capital Management Has Lowered By $860,000 Its Alibaba Group Holding Limited (BABA) Position; Great Western Bancorporation (GWB) Has 1.28 Sentiment
May 8, 2018 - By Marguerite Chambers
Firsthand Capital Management Inc decreased Alibaba Group Holding Limited (BABA) stake by 12.5% reported in 2017Q4 SEC filing. Firsthand Capital Management Inc sold 5,000 shares as Alibaba Group Holding Limited (BABA)’s stock rose 3.18%. The Firsthand Capital Management Inc holds 35,000 shares with $6.04M value, down from 40,000 last quarter. Alibaba Group Holding Limited now has $504.42 billion valuation. The stock increased 0.49% or $0.96 during the last trading session, reaching $196.31. About 21.49 million shares traded or 16.49% up from the average. Alibaba Group Holding Limited (NYSE:BABA) has risen 68.29% since May 8, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 56.74% the S&P500.
Great Western Bancorporation Inc (GWB) investors sentiment increased to 1.28 in 2017 Q4 . It’s up 0.04, from 1.24 in 2017Q3. The ratio improved, as 87 investment professionals increased or opened new holdings, while 68 sold and trimmed stakes in Great Western Bancorporation Inc. The investment professionals in our database now have: 59.52 million shares, down from 59.64 million shares in 2017Q3. Also, the number of investment professionals holding Great Western Bancorporation Inc in top ten holdings was flat from 0 to 0 for the same number . Sold All: 16 Reduced: 52 Increased: 66 New Position: 21.
Great Western Bancorp, Inc. operates as the bank holding firm for Great Western Bank that provides business and agribusiness banking, retail banking, and wealth management services. The company has market cap of $2.51 billion. The firm offers non-interest-bearing demand accounts, interest-bearing savings and money market accounts, individual retirement accounts, and time certificates of deposits, as well as NOW accounts. It has a 18.46 P/E ratio. It also provides agricultural loans; commercial and industrial loans, including working capital and other shorter-term lines of credit, and fixed-rate loans; commercial real estate loans comprising owner-occupied and non-owner-occupied CRE loans, multifamily residential real estate loans, and construction and development loans; short-term working capital funding, long-term land-related lending, and other tailored services; and residential mortgage loans, home equity loans, home equity lines of credit and general lines of credit, and auto loans and other loans.
The stock increased 0.95% or $0.4 during the last trading session, reaching $42.65. About 293,926 shares traded or 19.60% up from the average. Great Western Bancorp, Inc. (GWB) has declined 3.97% since May 8, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 15.52% the S&P500.
Jacobs Asset Management Llc holds 2.89% of its portfolio in Great Western Bancorp, Inc. for 383,468 shares. Mountain Pacific Investment Advisers Inc Id owns 370,608 shares or 1.55% of their US portfolio. Moreover, Stieven Capital Advisors L.P. has 1.19% invested in the company for 170,200 shares. The Colorado-based Tributary Capital Management Llc has invested 1.09% in the stock. Mairs & Power Inc, a Minnesota-based fund reported 2.16 million shares.
